messages:
michelle_pm: Heads-up — Customer ACME asked for an "low-latency batch mode" that automatically switches between single-request and microbatching based on observed QPS and tail latency. They want a pilot we can enable per-customer. Scope suggestions?

rahul_eng: High-level idea: adaptive microbatching with a short max_wait (10-30ms) + small batch cap (8-16). Switching signal = moving average QPS + recent p99 tail. Tradeoffs: lower latency but lower GPU utilization. Need fallback to fp16 when quality drops.

sara_ml: Important: any quantization (int8/int4) used with microbatching must have eval hooks so we can detect quality regressions on the customer prompt set. Propose eval-triggered alerts that fire on relative drops (e.g., recall/accuracy delta) and a simple canary metric baseline.

alex_cs: ACME is OK with slightly higher cost if p99 stays < 120ms for their core API. They can supply ~1k sample prompts for our eval harness.

tim_sre: Operational considerations: rollout must be per-customer feature-flagged + canary. Metrics we need: batch_size_dist, micro_wait_ms_hist, cache_hit_rate, end_to_end_p99, eval_alerts_count. Also put a circuit-breaker to disable adaptive batching globally on error spikes.

jenna_product: Draft launch criteria proposal: (1) p99 SLO met on sampled traffic for 48h in staging; (2) automated eval alerts detect <=2% quality regression threshold on customer set; (3) per-customer canary toggle; (4) runbook for fallback + diagnostics; (5) docs + SDK examples.

ci-bot: Deployment started: feature/microbatch-adaptive -> staging (build #7821)

rahul_eng: Prototype config snippet for the runtime:```yaml
microbatch:
  enabled: true
  mode: adaptive
  max_wait_ms: 20
  max_batch_size: 12
  switch_threshold_qps: 10
  quant_profile: int8  # optional, per-customer override
kv_cache:
  enabled: true
  pref: high
```

sara_ml: Example eval rule (pseudo):
```
if relative_drop(metric="exact_match", window=1000) > 0.02 && latency_reduction_pct > 10%:
  trigger_alert("quant_quality_regression")
```
We should tie alerts to a sampling policy that captures inputs for offline analysis.

michelle_pm: Action items: rahul - prototype + perf numbers (latency, throughput, cost delta) by EOD Fri; sara - wire eval hooks + propose default thresholds; tim - add per-customer canary flag + global circuit breaker; jenna - finalize acceptance checklist and coordinate ACME; alex - confirm prompt corpus and SLO tolerance with ACME.

alex_cs: :thumbsup: looping ACME in now. They also asked for an auto-fallback: when an eval-alert fires, traffic should automatically be routed to a full-precision variant and we should capture samples for root-cause.

rahul_eng: Auto-fallback plan: on eval-alert or manual quality report -> switch routing policy to fp16 variant for that customer, start 100% sample of requests to logging pipeline and escalate if alerts persist > 30m. Also log batch-size impact.

tim_sre: Also: need eviction/TTL docs for KV cache when used with microbatching. If cache hit_rate falls below X we should consider disabling microbatch to avoid latency thrash.

jenna_product: Prioritization: mark as pilot-tier feature. Proposed sprint plan (3 weeks): week1 prototype switch + canary flags, week2 eval hooks + alerts + fallback, week3 runbook + docs + staging soak.

michelle_pm: Sounds good. I'll draft the PRD and sprint ticket after this thread. Thanks all — please keep updates in this thread so I can fold into the PRD.

rahul_eng: Quick note: perf targets to capture — median latency, p95, p99, tokens/sec, GPU utilization delta, cost per 1M tokens.

alex_cs: ACME will send corpus by Tue.

michelle_pm: Great. If anyone thinks we should drop scope (e.g., int4) from pilot, say now — otherwise we'll include int8 and leave int4 for later.

sara_ml: Agree drop int4 for pilot; int8 + eval hooks is a good start.

jenna_product: Noted. I'll update scope.

michelle_pm: Closing thread for decisions: adaptive microbatch (int8 pilot), per-customer canary + auto-fallback to fp16, eval-triggered alerts + sampling, 3-week pilot sprint. I'll post PRD link when ready.
